issue: After-Round Big Board is the same world and the same first viewport as shogiful-b 'The Big Board Hall'. Both are a giant lit magnetic commentary board in a darkened hall, kept sticky while the commentary scrolls. Both centre a ~500–540px board with name plates or a hand tray on the left flank and the verdict, price, badge and QR on the right flank, and both draw red/coloured move arrows. Both are their surface's IMPECCABLE'S PICK, so the owner would see one style twice across two sibling apps. Its own risk line predicts this convergence.
fix: Keep the commentary board on shogiful-b: the ōban 大盤解説 is Shogiful's #1 and the more established institution. Replace xiangqiful-b with xiangqiful candidate #2, park stone tables (石桌棋盤): incised granite boards in park daylight, with the ring of onlookers as the read-back. No board-game style uses stone/architecture, and it gives Xiangqiful a light outdoor scene. Fira Sans Extra Condensed leaves with it.

issue: Below the hero, the three styles of each surface follow one section order with new labels. appmeta-a ≡ appmeta-b, gymlogger-x-a ≡ -b ≡ -c, rightsplit-b ≡ -c, shogiful-b ≡ -c, wanderwiki-a ≡ -b (-c swaps two blocks) and pawza-a ≡ -c. The xiangqiful, earnlock and millrace trios each differ by one swap. Across the 60 microsite styles, one order dominates: hero → quick answer → (quick reference) → how it works → screenshots → features → who_for/who_not_for → price → comparison → privacy → founder/about → (roadmap) → FAQ → further reading → closing. That is one static structure in 60 costumes, which is the thing the owner refused ('do not use the same static structure for each page, build them from scratch'). It also makes the three styles per page skin choices, not page choices.
fix: Re-derive every visitorPath from the world's own reading order, and enforce two rules. (1) Within a surface, no two styles may share the relative order of more than two of {price, screenshots, comparison, privacy record, founder, FAQ}. (2) At least one style per surface must change GROUPING, not just order: for example, FAQ split into the sections it answers, who_for/who_not_for folded into the price, or the privacy record as the opener. World-native examples: tare-b sets Puzzle No. 1 before the Rules and puts price and answers at the back like a book. studio-a, allpaid-c and rightsplit-a open with the record (bin label, statement, label data) before any feature. soon-b prints the fare and stub (price) on the face, first. gymlogger-x-c shows the plateau formula before any offer. xiangqiful-c files each FAQ as a margin question on the entry it concerns. observa-b ends on 'past issues' (release notes) instead of a closing CTA block. The maker/freshness line and the shared footer strip may stay common.

issue: Exact Steps Only shares Dela Gothic One (display) with shogiful-b. Its amber Doto dot-matrix numerals on black duplicate soon-c's countdown board (#FFB23F vs #FFB21E, both Doto 700), and Doto then sits in three surfaces. Its 'INSERT 2,026 STEPS' credit display is the same object as earnlock-c's giant remaining-steps count, so a and c lead with one move. Its own risk line also calls the machine a hero-only device with plain panels below, which makes it a hero skin.
fix: Dela Gothic One goes to shogiful-b, whose subject is Japanese. Set the marquee in Mochiy Pop One, a Japanese sticker/marquee gothic unused elsewhere. Make all price lamps lighting together the one move, and shrink the credit display to a small red 7-segment strip, as on real machines. That drops Doto here and leaves it on chessful-a and soon-c. Below the hero, keep the page on machine faces (side-panel plates, the audit printout, the pickup bin) instead of plain set panels.

issue: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next is the text face in seven surfaces: studio-a, aftershift-a, allpaid-b, appmeta-pulse-a, mediakit-b, observa-a and shogiful-b. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono is the data face in four: aftershift-a, allpaid-b, observa-a and shogiful-b. This monoculture will make the microsites read alike below their heroes.
fix: Keep it on two surfaces: aftershift-a (low acuity after a night shift) and allpaid-b (display and text, read from across the room). Swap the rest. studio-a → Work Sans. appmeta-pulse-a → B612 400/700 for text, one cockpit family with its display and B612 Mono. mediakit-b → Overpass 400/700 for text, one family with its display. observa-a → League Spartan with tabular figures and no mono (see the observa-a issue). shogiful-b → Murecho 400/600 for the commentary, with tabular figures for notation.

issue: A hand-annotation layer (a handwriting font, ballpoint or pencil over a printed form) appears in about ten styles: aftershift-b, pawza-b, rightsplit-b, taskful-day-b, xiangqiful-c, tare-b, millrace-c, shogiful-a, appmeta-b and chessful-b. Four share one ballpoint blue (#1F3BA0, #1E3FA6, #1F3FB4, #2340A0). It is this board's own default. In three styles it is pure decoration: aftershift-b's Reenie Beanie notes repeat existing copy, millrace-c has Kalam coach and hint lines, and shogiful-a has Yusei Magic marker notes.
fix: Keep a hand layer only where the hand performs the mechanism: rightsplit-b (circling who ordered what), tare-b (solving in pencil), xiangqiful-c (the teacher's red pen), taskful-day-b (writing tomorrow's card), pawza-b (the as-written layer the scan reads) and appmeta-b (proof marks). Cut it from aftershift-b, millrace-c and shogiful-a, which also ends the Reenie Beanie share. Convert chessful-b's pen to print (see the chessful-b issue).

issue: Admit One's ticket card (#F3C6D2, 'cherry-blossom pink') is the same pale pink as shogiful-c's first newsprint signature (#F3CBD2). Its sakura reading also points at the Japanese costume that Shogiful's category default warns against.
fix: shogiful-c keeps the pink, because tinted manga signatures are native to it. Print soon-b's ticket on a stock no other surface uses, e.g. pale aqua card (~#C4E6E1). Keep the aubergine ink and the app-blue spot, and re-check blue text on the new stock for 4.5:1.

issue: Shantell Sans is taskful-day-b's display face (the H1 and the written layer) and shogiful-c's speech-balloon lettering.
fix: taskful-day-b keeps it. Letter shogiful-c's balloons in Patrick Hand SC (unused), a caps comic-style hand.

issue: The Club Tag Wall's colour carriers are hinoki wood tags, vermilion hanko stamps and Shippori Mincho. That is the wood + red seal + mincho reading of 'Japan' that Shogiful's category default (wood board, kanji, sakura) predicts.
fix: Let the celadon plaster and the lacquer rails carry the page. Use vermilion only for the YOU tag and the focus ring. Drop the decorative hanko category stamps in favour of the printed ○△× marks, and keep wood grain on the tags themselves at low contrast.

issue: Raster weight is unbudgeted everywhere. Every microsite puts the app icon in its nav or hero at 24 to 72px, and most put screenshots in carousels or heroes. The only files that exist are 1024px icon PNGs of 0.56 to 3.96 MB (mediakit.png is 3.96 MB; lagerland-mark.png is 1.96 MB, and the current header already ships it at 30px) and 1206x2622 screenshot PNGs of 0.3 to 7.6 MB (soon/2.png is 7.6 MB, mediakit/2.png is 7.1 MB). Nearly every card says assetsNeeded: none, so no style accounts for derivatives. Shipped as-is, a 390px page downloads several MB before the badge is usable.
fix: Add one production task to every style: a one-off script in scripts/ (already excluded from the build, so it is not a deploy build step) that commits derivatives. Icons at 64, 128 and 256px (WebP plus a PNG fallback, about 15 KB or less at 128). Screenshots at 400w, 800w and 1200w WebP (about 40, 90 and 160 KB or less). The studio mark as the clean SVG that studio a/b/c already ask for. Front matter keeps the original paths; one include maps them to the derivatives and emits width/height, srcset/sizes, loading=lazy and decoding=async (eager plus fetchpriority=high only for a single hero image).

issue: Sticky bars hide focus (WCAG 2.2 AA 2.4.11). Every style adds a sticky download bar after the hero, and most also pin a top strip; earnlock-c also fixes side rims, shogiful-a keeps a tag rail and soon-a an earth bar. A focused link, FAQ summary or #anchor target can land underneath them. On a Safari viewport of about 664px, two 52 to 64px bars plus the Smart App Banner can cover more than a quarter of the screen.
fix: Make it a global contract: html { scroll-padding-top: var(--sticky-top); scroll-padding-bottom: var(--sticky-bottom) }, so focus and anchors never land under a bar. Allow one sticky element per edge, pad the bottom bar with env(safe-area-inset-bottom), and on viewports shorter than 600px hide the top strip while the bottom bar is showing.

issue: On mobile the badge is at the bottom edge of the 844px plan (b: y748 to 844; c: narration box at y712 to 844). That is below the roughly 580 to 750px a phone browser actually shows.
fix: Style c: put the white narration box with price and badge directly after the title panel (about y248) and move the board panel below it. Style b changes world under the collision fix; its new plan must keep the badge's bottom at y560 or above.

issue: Same world and mechanism as xiangqiful-b: a dark hall (#1C2230 vs #232220), a lit demonstration board, a sticky board reset from SFEN/FEN at each caption, sliding pieces and arrows that draw. Shogiful-b's type stack also collides three ways: Dela Gothic One is earnlock-a's display, and Atkinson Hyperlegible Next and Mono are a monoculture.
fix: Keep the big board on xiangqiful-b, whose type is clean and which already handles mobile with a diagram per chapter. Move shogiful-b to its candidate #3 (the kifu record sheet). Skip #2 (the tsume problem book), which would collide with tare-b's Japanese puzzle-book world. Reset the type along with it, for example Murecho 900/400/700: one Japanese-drawn gothic, about 40 KB of latin, with tabular figures for notation and no mono.

issue: Layout shift from huge display headlines. Many heroes set 100 to 128px condensed or expanded H1s (millrace-c Antonio at 128px, soon-b at 128px, allpaid-a at 112px, gymlogger-x-a at 112px, liftlog-a at wdth 125). When the font swaps in from a system fallback with very different widths, the H1 reflows and the hero shifts.
fix: For each display face, declare a metric-matched fallback @font-face (size-adjust, ascent-override and descent-override over a local system face), preload only the display file, and use font-display: swap for text faces and optional for the giant H1 face.

issue: Hidden CJK payload: the piece guide and labels carry kanji and kana (style a has 18 distinct characters in the card, style c 21). If the build copies Fontsource's full CSS, the browser fetches the unicode-range chunks for those characters (Shippori Mincho B1 averages about 43 KB per chunk, BIZ UDPGothic about 23 KB, Zen Old Mincho about 22 KB) and breaks the 160 KB budget. Tare-b's Zen faces and earnlock-a's M PLUS and Dela carry the same risk.
fix: Self-host only the latin (and any needed latin-ext) @font-face rules and let CJK fall back to the system Japanese face (Hiragino on Apple). If a kanji must appear in the brand face, subset just those characters with the same scripts/ process as xiangqiful.

issue: Shared face: the balloon lettering is Shantell Sans, which is taskful-day-b's display.
fix: Letter the balloons in Comic Neue 700 (19 KB), the open stand-in for comic lettering, and leave Shantell to taskful-day-b's written layer.

issue: a's 'club information card' and c's 'manga character data box' list only platforms, engine, price, offline and account in place of the ai-canonical body.
fix: Render the app.html ai-canonical content verbatim in the card or data box. Style b's open plate is the model.

issue: On mobile the narration box with price and badge sits at y712-844, the last 130px of the frame. Safari's bottom toolbar covers that band on load, so the badge is effectively below the fold.
fix: Move the narration box (price and badge) directly under the title panel at about y250, and let the board panel and balloon follow.
